```{r}
library(ROCR)
library(rpart)          # Decision Tree
library(rpart.plot)     # Tree visualisation
library(e1071)          # Naive Bayes
library(ipred)          # Bagging
library(adabag)         # Boosting
library(randomForest)   # Random Forest
library(pROC)           # ROC / AUC
library(caret)          # confusionMatrix, cross-validation
library(nnet)           # Artificial Neural Network
library(dplyr)          # Data wrangling
library(ggplot2)        # Plotting
library(knitr)          # kable() tables
library(kableExtra)     # kable styling (striped rows, bold columns etc.)
library(tidyr)          # pivot_longer for long-format plotting
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# DATA CREATION
# ============================================================
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(33986010) # Your Student ID is the random seed
WD = read.csv("WVSBinaryExtract.csv")
selected_cols = c(sample(3:49, 30),sample(50:63, 3))
WD = WD[c(1:2, selected_cols)]
WD = WD[sample(nrow(WD), 20000, replace = FALSE),]

cat("Dimensions:", dim(WD), "\n")
cat("Columns:", paste(names(WD), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Last 3 columns = binary class variables (sampled from cols 50-63)
class_vars <- tail(names(WD), 3)
cat("Class variables:", paste(class_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# QUESTION 1 - Data Exploration
# ============================================================
cat("\n===== Q1: Data Exploration =====\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1a. Class variable proportions
# ----------------------------------------------------------
prop_rows <- list()

for (cv in class_vars) {
  tbl  <- table(factor(WD[[cv]], levels = c(0, 1)))
  prop <- prop.table(tbl)
  
  ratio <- if (min(prop) == 0) NA else max(prop) / min(prop)
  
  prop_rows[[cv]] <- data.frame(
    Class_Variable = cv,
    N_High         = as.integer(tbl["1"]),
    N_Low          = as.integer(tbl["0"]),
    Prop_High      = round(as.numeric(prop["1"]), 4),
    Prop_Low       = round(as.numeric(prop["0"]), 4),
    ImbalRatio     = round(ratio, 3)
  )
}

prop_df <- do.call(rbind, prop_rows)
rownames(prop_df) <- NULL

kable(prop_df,
      caption = "Table 1. Class variable proportions (High = 1, Low = 0)",
      col.names = c("Class Variable", "Number of High", "Number of Low",
                    "Proportions High", "Proportions Low", "Imbalance Ratio")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE)
           

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1b. Predictor summary statistics (kable replacing summary())
# ----------------------------------------------------------
predictors <- WD[, 3:(ncol(WD) - 3)]
pred_cols  <- names(predictors)

stats_df <- data.frame(
  Variable  = pred_cols,
  Mean      = round(sapply(predictors, mean,   na.rm = TRUE), 3),
  SD        = round(sapply(predictors, sd,     na.rm = TRUE), 3),
  Min       = round(sapply(predictors, min,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
  Median    = round(sapply(predictors, median, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
  Max       = round(sapply(predictors, max,    na.rm = TRUE), 3),
  N_Missing = as.integer(colSums(is.na(predictors))),
  N_Negative = as.integer(sapply(predictors,
                                  function(x) sum(x < 0, na.rm = TRUE)))
)
rownames(stats_df) <- NULL

kable(stats_df,
      caption = paste("Table 2. Summary statistics of predictor attributes",
                      "(N =", nrow(WD), "). N_Negative indicates WVS",
                      "system-missing codes (-1 to -5) requiring removal."),
      col.names = c("Variable", "Mean", "SD", "Min",
                    "Median", "Max", "N Missing", "N Negative"),
      row.names = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE) |>
  column_spec(8, bold = TRUE,
              color = ifelse(stats_df$N_Negative > 0, "red", "black"))


# Histograms for all numeric predictors (4 per page)
num_pred_names <- names(predictors)
n_preds <- length(num_pred_names)
par(mfrow=c(5,6), mar=c(2,2,2,1))
for (nm in num_pred_names) {
  hist(predictors[[nm]], main=nm, xlab="", col="lightblue",
       breaks=15, cex.main=0.85)
}
par(mfrow=c(1,1))

# Box plots for all numeric predictors
par(mfrow=c(5,6), mar=c(2,2,2,1))
for (nm in num_pred_names) {
  boxplot(predictors[[nm]], main=nm, xlab="", col="lightblue",
          cex.main=0.85, outline=TRUE)
}
par(mfrow=c(1,1))

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# 1c.  NA and Negative Value Summary
# ----------------------------------------------------------
# Count NAs (including negative-coded WVS values)
WD_raw_check <- WD  # before pre-processing negatives are already in the data
neg_na_counts <- sapply(WD[pred_cols], function(x) sum(x < 0 | is.na(x), na.rm = TRUE))
pct_missing   <- round(neg_na_counts / nrow(WD) * 100, 2)
 
missing_df <- data.frame(
  Attribute      = names(neg_na_counts),
  Missing_Count  = as.vector(neg_na_counts),
  Missing_Pct    = as.vector(pct_missing)
)
missing_df <- missing_df[order(-missing_df$Missing_Pct), ]
 
cat("\n--- Missing / Negative-Coded Values per Predictor ---\n")
kable(missing_df,
      caption = "Table 1. Missing and negative-coded values per predictor attribute",
      row.names = FALSE,
      format = "html") %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "center",
    font_size = 14
  ) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#4472C4", color = "white") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "20em") %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%")
 
# Bar chart of % missing
par(mar = c(8, 4, 3, 1))
barplot(missing_df$Missing_Pct,
        names.arg = missing_df$Attribute,
        las       = 2,
        col       = ifelse(missing_df$Missing_Pct > 30, "tomato", "steelblue"),
        ylab      = "% Missing / Negative-coded",
        main      = "Figure. Percentage of missing values per predictor",
        cex.names = 0.65)
abline(h = 30, lty = 2, col = "red")
legend("topright", legend = "30% threshold", lty = 2, col = "red")
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))

```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# QUESTION 2 - Pre-processing
# ============================================================
cat("\n===== Q2: Pre-processing =====\n")

WD_clean  <- WD
pred_cols <- names(WD_clean)[3:(ncol(WD_clean) - 3)]

# Replace WVS negative system-missing codes with NA
for (col in pred_cols) {
  if (is.numeric(WD_clean[[col]])) {
    WD_clean[[col]][WD_clean[[col]] < 0] <- NA
  }
}

# Remove rows where any class variable is NA
WD_clean <- WD_clean[complete.cases(WD_clean[, class_vars]), ]

# Impute remaining predictor NAs with column median
for (col in pred_cols) {
  if (is.numeric(WD_clean[[col]])) {
    med <- median(WD_clean[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
    WD_clean[[col]][is.na(WD_clean[[col]])] <- med
  }
}

# Convert class variables to factors (0 = Low, 1 = High)
for (cv in class_vars) {
  WD_clean[[cv]] <- factor(WD_clean[[cv]], levels = c(0, 1),
                           labels = c("Low", "High"))
  cat(sprintf("  %s -> factor levels: %s\n", cv,
              paste(levels(WD[[cv]]), collapse = ", ")))
}

# Convert Country and Wave to factors (categorical identifiers)
WD_clean$Country <- as.factor(WD_clean$Country)
WD_clean$Wave    <- as.factor(WD_clean$Wave)

# Scaling / Standardisation 
cat("\n--- 2f. Scaling note ---\n")
cat("  Scaling deferred to Q11 (ANN only).\n")
cat("  Tree-based models and Naive Bayes are scale-invariant.\n")
 
# Final Dataset Overview 
cat("\n--- 2g. Final dataset dimensions after pre-processing ---\n")
final_summary <- data.frame(
  Item  = c("Total observations", "Predictor columns",
            "Convert class variables to factors (High/Low)", "Remaining NAs"),
  Value = c(nrow(WD_clean), length(pred_cols), paste(paste(class_vars, collapse = ", "), "converted"), sum(is.na(WD_clean)))
)
print(kable(final_summary,
            caption = "Table 6. Dataset summary after pre-processing",
            row.names = FALSE))
 
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# QUESTION 3: Train/Test Split (70/30)
# ============================================================
cat("\n========== QUESTION 3: TRAIN/TEST SPLIT ==========\n")

set.seed(33986010)
train.row <- sample(1:nrow(WD_clean), 0.7 * nrow(WD_clean))
WD.train  <- WD_clean[train.row, ]
WD.test   <- WD_clean[-train.row, ]

cat("Training set size:", nrow(WD.train), "\n")
cat("Test set size:    ", nrow(WD.test),  "\n")

# Define predictor columns (exclude Country, Wave, and all class vars)
all_cols     <- names(WD)
non_pred     <- c("Country", "Wave", class_vars)
pred_cols    <- setdiff(all_cols, non_pred)
cat("Predictor columns used:", length(pred_cols), "\n")

# ============================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================

# Build formula: class_var ~ predictors
make_formula <- function(cv, preds) {
  as.formula(paste(cv, "~", paste(preds, collapse = " + ")))
}

# Compute metrics from confusion matrix
get_metrics <- function(cm) {
  # cm is a 2x2 table: rows=predicted, cols=actual; labels Low/High
  # Positive class = "High"
  tp <- cm["High", "High"]
  tn <- cm["Low",  "Low"]
  fp <- cm["High", "Low"]
  fn <- cm["Low",  "High"]
  acc  <- (tp + tn) / sum(cm)
  prec <- ifelse((tp + fp) == 0, 0, tp / (tp + fp))
  rec  <- ifelse((tp + fn) == 0, 0, tp / (tp + fn))
  f1   <- ifelse((prec + rec) == 0, 0, 2 * prec * rec / (prec + rec))
  c(Accuracy=round(acc,4), Precision=round(prec,4),
    Recall=round(rec,4), F1=round(f1,4))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# QUESTION 4: Fit Models on Training Data
# ============================================================
cat("\n========== QUESTION 4: MODEL FITTING ==========\n")

model_names <- c("Decision Tree", "Naive Bayes", "Bagging",
                 "Boosting", "Random Forest")

prob_list <- list()

for (cv in class_vars) {
  cat("\n---------- Class Variable:", cv, "----------\n")
  fml <- make_formula(cv, pred_cols)

  # ---- 4a. Decision Tree with cross-validation pruning ----
  cat("  Fitting Decision Tree...\n")
  dt.model <- rpart(fml, data = WD.train, method = "class",
                    control = rpart.control(xval = 10))   # 10-fold cross-validation
  
  # Prune using optimal CP from cross-validation
  best_cp <- dt.model$cptable[which.min(dt.model$cptable[, "xerror"]), "CP"]
  dt.model <- prune(dt.model, cp = best_cp)
  
  if (!is.null(dt.model$splits) && nrow(dt.model$splits) > 0) {
    # extra = 106: shows predicted class + % of observations in node + n
    # type  = 0:   simple lines like plain plot(), no boxes
    rpart.plot(dt.model,
           type        = 0,
           extra       = 106,
           under       = TRUE,
           cex         = 0.75,
           digits      = 2,
           roundint    = FALSE,    # stops rounding to nearest integer
           main        = paste("Figure: Decision Tree -", cv),
           box.palette = "auto",
           shadow.col  = "gray")
  } else {
    cat("  Note: single-node tree for", cv,
        "- no splits produced (class imbalance). Only CGovernment is plotted.\n")
  }

  # ---- 4b. Naive Bayes ----
  cat("  Fitting Naive Bayes...\n")
  nb.model <- naiveBayes(fml, data = WD.train)
  # Print number of predictor conditional tables as evidence of fitting
  cat("  Naive Bayes fitted with", length(nb.model$tables), "predictor distributions.\n")
 
  # ---- 4c. Bagging ----
  cat("  Fitting Bagging...\n")
  bag.model <- adabag::bagging(fml, data = WD.train, mfinal = 25)
  cat("  Bagging fitted with", bag.model$terms |> length(), "terms,",
      length(bag.model$trees), "trees.\n")
 
  # ---- 4d. Boosting ----
  cat("  Fitting Boosting...\n")
  bst.model <- adabag::boosting(fml, data = WD.train, mfinal = 25)
  cat("  Boosting fitted with", length(bst.model$trees), "trees.\n")
 
  # ---- 4e. Random Forest ----
  cat("  Fitting Random Forest...\n")
  rf.model <- randomForest(fml, data = WD.train, ntree = 100, importance = TRUE)
  print(rf.model)   # prints OOB error, class error table — useful evidence
  
  # Store models
  assign(paste0("dt_",  cv), dt.model)
  assign(paste0("nb_",  cv), nb.model)
  assign(paste0("bag_", cv), bag.model)
  assign(paste0("bst_", cv), bst.model)
  assign(paste0("rf_",  cv), rf.model)

  # Store predicted probabilities for Q6
  bag.raw <- adabag::predict.bagging(bag.model, newdata = WD.test)
  bst.raw <- adabag::predict.boosting(bst.model, newdata = WD.test)

  prob_list[[cv]] <- list(
    "Decision Tree" = predict(dt.model, WD.test, type = "prob")[, "High"],
    "Naive Bayes"   = predict(nb.model, WD.test, type = "raw")[, "High"],
    "Bagging"       = bag.raw$prob[, 2],
    "Boosting"      = bst.raw$prob[, 2],
    "Random Forest" = predict(rf.model, WD.test, type = "prob")[, "High"]
  )

  cat("  All models fitted for", cv, "\n")
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# QUESTION 5: MODEL EVALUATION - Grouped Confusion Matrices
# ============================================================
cat("\n========== QUESTION 5: MODEL EVALUATION ==========\n")

results_list <- list()

for (cv in class_vars) {
  cat("\n---------- Class Variable:", cv, "----------\n")

  actual <- WD.test[[cv]]

  # Generate predictions
  dt.pred  <- predict(get(paste0("dt_",  cv)), WD.test, type = "class")
  nb.pred  <- predict(get(paste0("nb_",  cv)), WD.test)
  bag.pred <- factor(predict.bagging(get(paste0("bag_", cv)),
                                     newdata = WD.test)$class,
                     levels = c("Low", "High"))
  bst.pred <- factor(predict.boosting(get(paste0("bst_", cv)),
                                      newdata = WD.test)$class,
                     levels = c("Low", "High"))
  rf.pred  <- predict(get(paste0("rf_",  cv)), WD.test)

  # Build confusion matrices
  cms <- list(
    "Decision Tree" = table(Predicted = dt.pred,  Actual = actual),
    "Naive Bayes"   = table(Predicted = nb.pred,  Actual = actual),
    "Bagging"       = table(Predicted = bag.pred, Actual = actual),
    "Boosting"      = table(Predicted = bst.pred, Actual = actual),
    "Random Forest" = table(Predicted = rf.pred,  Actual = actual)
  )

  # Build 1 wide table with all 5 confusion matrices side by side ---
  cm_wide <- data.frame(Predicted = c("Low", "High"))
  
  for (mn in names(cms)) {
    cm <- as.data.frame.matrix(cms[[mn]])
    # Add Low and High columns with model name prefix
    cm_wide[[paste0(mn, "_Low")]]  <- c(cm["Low",  "Low"],  cm["High", "Low"])
    cm_wide[[paste0(mn, "_High")]] <- c(cm["Low",  "High"], cm["High", "High"])
  }

  # Build header: Predicted | DT: Low High | NB: Low High | ...
  n_models  <- length(cms)
  col_names <- c("Predicted",
                 unlist(lapply(names(cms), function(mn) c("Low", "High"))))
  
  header_top <- c(" " = 1)
  for (mn in names(cms)) header_top[mn] <- 2

  cat("\n### Confusion Matrices (All Models) –", cv, "\n")
  print(
    kable(cm_wide,
          col.names = col_names,
          caption   = paste("Confusion Matrices for all models –", cv),
          align     = c("l", rep("c", n_models * 2))) %>%
      kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "condensed"),
        full_width        = TRUE,
        font_size         = 12) %>%
      add_header_above(header_top) %>%
      add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Actual Class" = n_models * 2)) %>%
      column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
      row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#4472C4", color = "white")
  )

  # --- Performance Metrics Table ---
  metrics_mat <- t(sapply(cms, get_metrics))
  results_list[[cv]] <- metrics_mat

  metrics_df       <- as.data.frame(metrics_mat)
  metrics_df$Model <- rownames(metrics_df)
  metrics_df       <- metrics_df[, c("Model","Accuracy","Precision","Recall","F1")]
  rownames(metrics_df) <- NULL

  best_f1_row <- which.max(metrics_df$F1)

  cat("\n### Performance Metrics –", cv, "\n")
  print(
    kable(metrics_df,
          caption = paste("Table: Q5 Performance Metrics –", cv),
          digits  = 4,
          align   = c("l","c","c","c","c")) %>%
      kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","bordered","condensed"),
        full_width        = FALSE,
        font_size         = 13) %>%
      row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#4472C4", color = "white") %>%
      row_spec(best_f1_row, bold = TRUE, background = "#E8F5E9") %>%
      column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
      column_spec(5, bold = TRUE)
  )
}
 
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# QUESTION 6: ROC Curves & AUC
# ============================================================
cat("\n========== QUESTION 6: ROC CURVES & AUC ==========\n")

colors_roc <- c("blue", "red", "green3", "purple", "orange")
auc_list   <- list()

# ---- Plot all 3 ROC curves first ----
for (cv in class_vars) {
  actual_bin <- ifelse(WD.test[[cv]] == "High", 1, 0)
  probs      <- prob_list[[cv]]
  
  auc_vals        <- numeric(length(model_names))
  names(auc_vals) <- model_names
  
  plot(0, 0, type = "n", xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1),
       xlab = "False Positive Rate", ylab = "True Positive Rate",
       main = paste("ROC Curves -", cv))
  abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "grey")
  
  for (i in seq_along(model_names)) {
    mn  <- model_names[i]
    prd <- ROCR::prediction(probs[[mn]], actual_bin)
    prf <- ROCR::performance(prd, "tpr", "fpr")
    auc <- round(ROCR::performance(prd, "auc")@y.values[[1]], 4)
    auc_vals[mn] <- auc
    plot(prf, col = colors_roc[i], lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
  }
  
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = paste(model_names, "| AUC:", auc_vals),
         col    = colors_roc, lwd = 2, cex = 0.7)
  
  auc_list[[cv]] <- auc_vals
}

# ---- Print all 3 AUC tables after ----
for (cv in class_vars) {
  cat("\nAUC values for", cv, ":\n")
  print(
    kable(data.frame(AUC = auc_list[[cv]]),
          caption = paste("Table: Q6 AUC -", cv),
          digits  = 4) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                    full_width = FALSE)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# QUESTION 7: Compare Classifiers
# ============================================================
cat("\n========== QUESTION 7: CLASSIFIER COMPARISON ==========\n")

# Full summary table per class variable (metrics + AUC)
for (cv in class_vars) {
  cat("\n--- Full performance summary for:", cv, "---\n")
  df      <- as.data.frame(results_list[[cv]])
  df$AUC  <- auc_list[[cv]]
  print(kable(df,
              caption = paste("Table: Q7 Full Metrics –", cv),
              digits  = 4) %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                        full_width = FALSE))
}

# Best & worst classifier per class variable by F1
cat("\n--- Best & Worst Classifiers by F1-score ---\n")
bw_df <- data.frame()
for (cv in class_vars) {
  f1s   <- results_list[[cv]][, "F1"]
  best  <- names(which.max(f1s))
  worst <- names(which.min(f1s))
  bw_df <- rbind(bw_df,
                 data.frame(ClassVar = cv,
                            Best     = best,  BestF1  = round(max(f1s), 4),
                            Worst    = worst, WorstF1 = round(min(f1s), 4)))
}
print(kable(bw_df,
            caption = "Table: Q7 Best and Worst Classifiers by F1") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                      full_width = FALSE))

# Worst ensemble (Bagging / Boosting / Random Forest) by average F1
cat("\n--- Worst Ensemble by Average F1 across all class variables ---\n")
ens_names <- c("Bagging", "Boosting", "Random Forest")
ens_avg   <- sapply(ens_names, function(en) {
  mean(sapply(class_vars, function(cv) results_list[[cv]][en, "F1"]))
})
print(kable(data.frame(Ensemble = ens_names, Avg_F1 = round(ens_avg, 4)),
            caption = "Table: Q7 Average F1 per Ensemble Model") %>%
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                      full_width = FALSE))
worst_ens <- names(which.min(ens_avg))
cat("Worst ensemble overall:", worst_ens, "\n")
```

```{r}

# ============================================================
# QUESTION 8: Feature Importance (Ensemble Models)
# ============================================================
cat("\n========== QUESTION 8: FEATURE IMPORTANCE ==========\n")

for (cv in class_vars) {
  cat("\n---------- Feature Importance for:", cv, "----------\n")

  bag_obj <- get(paste0("bag_", cv))
  bst_obj <- get(paste0("bst_", cv))
  rf_obj  <- get(paste0("rf_",  cv))

  # adabag stores $importance as a named numeric vector
  bag_imp <- sort(bag_obj$importance, decreasing = TRUE)
  bst_imp <- sort(bst_obj$importance, decreasing = TRUE)
  rf_imp  <- sort(importance(rf_obj)[, "MeanDecreaseGini"], decreasing = TRUE)

  bag_df <- data.frame(Attribute  = names(bag_imp),
                       Importance = round(as.vector(bag_imp), 4))
  bst_df <- data.frame(Attribute  = names(bst_imp),
                       Importance = round(as.vector(bst_imp), 4))
  rf_df  <- data.frame(Attribute  = names(rf_imp),
                       Importance = round(rf_imp, 4))

  # Top-10 combined table
  imp_combined <- data.frame(
    Rank     = 1:10,
    Bagging  = head(bag_df$Attribute, 10),
    Boosting = head(bst_df$Attribute, 10),
    RF       = head(rf_df$Attribute,  10)
  )
  print(kable(imp_combined,
              caption = paste("Table: Q8 Top-10 Important Attributes –", cv)) %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                        full_width = FALSE))

  # Bar charts for all three ensemble models side by side
  par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(8, 4, 3, 1))

  barplot(head(bag_df$Importance, 15),
          names.arg = head(bag_df$Attribute, 15),
          las = 2, col = "steelblue", cex.names = 0.65,
          main = paste("(a) Bagging –", cv),
          ylab = "Importance")

  barplot(head(bst_df$Importance, 15),
          names.arg = head(bst_df$Attribute, 15),
          las = 2, col = "tomato", cex.names = 0.65,
          main = paste("(b) Boosting –", cv),
          ylab = "Importance")

  barplot(head(rf_df$Importance, 15),
          names.arg = head(rf_df$Attribute, 15),
          las = 2, col = "seagreen", cex.names = 0.65,
          main = paste("(c) Random Forest –", cv),
          ylab = "Mean Decrease Gini")

  mtext(paste("Figure: Feature Importance –", cv),
        outer = TRUE, line = -1.5, cex = 0.9)
  par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# QUESTION 10: Improve the Worst Ensemble Model ##############
# ============================================================
cat("\n========== QUESTION 10: IMPROVE WORST ENSEMBLE ==========\n")
cat("Worst ensemble identified:", worst_ens, "\n")

# --- Attribute selection: union of top-15 RF features per class variable ---
top_attrs_list <- lapply(class_vars, function(cv) {
  rf_imp <- importance(get(paste0("rf_", cv)))[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  names(sort(rf_imp, decreasing = TRUE))[1:15]
})
top_attrs <- unique(unlist(top_attrs_list))
top_attrs <- intersect(top_attrs, pred_cols)
cat("Top attributes selected for improved model:", length(top_attrs), "\n")
cat(paste(top_attrs, collapse = ", "), "\n")

improved_results <- list()
improved_probs   <- list()

for (cv in class_vars) {
  cat("\n--- Improved model for:", cv, "---\n")
  fml_imp <- make_formula(cv, top_attrs)

  if (worst_ens == "Boosting") {
    imp.model <- adabag::boosting(fml_imp, data = WD.train,
                                   mfinal = 100, coeflearn = "Breiman")
    imp.raw   <- adabag::predict.boosting(imp.model, newdata = WD.test)
    imp.class <- factor(imp.raw$class, levels = c("Low", "High"))
    imp.prob  <- imp.raw$prob[, 2]   # col 2 = "High"

  } else if (worst_ens == "Bagging") {
    imp.model <- adabag::bagging(fml_imp, data = WD.train, mfinal = 100)
    imp.raw   <- adabag::predict.bagging(imp.model, newdata = WD.test)
    imp.class <- factor(imp.raw$class, levels = c("Low", "High"))
    imp.prob  <- imp.raw$prob[, 2]   # col 2 = "High"

  } else {
    # Random Forest
    imp.model <- randomForest(fml_imp, data = WD.train,
                               ntree      = 200,
                               mtry       = floor(sqrt(length(top_attrs))),
                               importance = TRUE)
    imp.class <- predict(imp.model, WD.test)
    imp.prob  <- predict(imp.model, WD.test, type = "prob")[, "High"]
  }

  actual  <- WD.test[[cv]]
  cm_imp  <- table(Predicted = imp.class, Actual = actual)
  cat("Confusion matrix (improved):\n")
  print(cm_imp)

  metrics_imp <- get_metrics(cm_imp)
  orig_f1     <- results_list[[cv]][worst_ens, "F1"]
  cat(sprintf("  Original %s F1: %.4f  |  Improved F1: %.4f\n",
              worst_ens, orig_f1, metrics_imp["F1"]))

  improved_results[[cv]] <- metrics_imp
  improved_probs[[cv]]   <- imp.prob
}

# ROC curves: original vs improved
cat("\n--- ROC curves: original vs improved ---\n")
for (cv in class_vars) {
  actual_bin <- ifelse(WD.test[[cv]] == "High", 1, 0)
  orig_prob  <- prob_list[[cv]][[worst_ens]]
  imp_prob   <- improved_probs[[cv]]

  prd_orig <- ROCR::prediction(orig_prob, actual_bin)
  prd_imp  <- ROCR::prediction(imp_prob,  actual_bin)
  prf_orig <- ROCR::performance(prd_orig, "tpr", "fpr")
  prf_imp  <- ROCR::performance(prd_imp,  "tpr", "fpr")
  auc_orig <- round(ROCR::performance(prd_orig, "auc")@y.values[[1]], 4)
  auc_imp  <- round(ROCR::performance(prd_imp,  "auc")@y.values[[1]], 4)

  plot(prf_orig, col = "red",  lwd = 2,
       main = paste("Figure: Q10 Improved", worst_ens, "–", cv))
  plot(prf_imp,  col = "blue", lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
  abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "grey")
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = c(paste("Original AUC:", auc_orig),
                    paste("Improved AUC:", auc_imp)),
         col = c("red", "blue"), lwd = 2)

  # Comparison table
  orig_m  <- results_list[[cv]][worst_ens, ]
  comp_df <- data.frame(
    Model     = c("Original", "Improved"),
    Accuracy  = c(orig_m["Accuracy"],  improved_results[[cv]]["Accuracy"]),
    Precision = c(orig_m["Precision"], improved_results[[cv]]["Precision"]),
    Recall    = c(orig_m["Recall"],    improved_results[[cv]]["Recall"]),
    F1        = c(orig_m["F1"],        improved_results[[cv]]["F1"]),
    AUC       = c(auc_orig,            auc_imp)
  )
  print(kable(comp_df,
              caption = paste("Table: Q10 Original vs Improved –", cv),
              digits  = 4) %>%
          kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed"),
                        full_width = FALSE))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# QUESTION 11: Artificial Neural Network
# ============================================================
cat("\n========== QUESTION 11: ARTIFICIAL NEURAL NETWORK ==========\n")

# Identify country with most observations
country_counts <- sort(table(WD_clean$Country), decreasing = TRUE)
cat("Observations per country (top 5):\n")
print(head(country_counts, 5))

top_country <- names(country_counts)[1]
cat("Selected country:", top_country, "\n")

# Bar chart: all countries, selected one highlighted in red
par(mar = c(8, 4, 3, 1))
barplot(country_counts,
        las       = 2,
        col       = ifelse(names(country_counts) == top_country,
                           "tomato", "steelblue"),
        main      = paste("Figure: Observations per Country (selected =",
                          top_country, "in red)"),
        ylab      = "Count",
        cex.names = 0.55)
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))

# Select class variable for ANN
# Using first class variable (CWomensMvt) based on Q8 insights
cv_ann <- class_vars[1]
cat("Class variable for ANN:", cv_ann, "\n")

# Step 3: Subset ALL cleaned data for selected country
WD_country_all <- WD_clean[WD_clean$Country == top_country, ]
cat("Total observations for", top_country, ":", nrow(WD_country_all), "\n")

# Also prepare test subset for Q12 wave evaluation
WD_test_country <- WD.test[WD.test$Country == top_country, ]
cat("Test observations for", top_country, ":", nrow(WD_test_country), "\n")

# Select top predictors from Q8 feature importance
top_ann_attrs <- unique(unlist(lapply(class_vars, function(cv) {
  rf_imp <- importance(get(paste0("rf_", cv)))[, "MeanDecreaseGini"]
  names(sort(rf_imp, decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
})))
top_ann_attrs <- intersect(top_ann_attrs, pred_cols)
cat("Number of selected predictors for ANN:", length(top_ann_attrs), "\n")
cat("Selected predictors:", paste(top_ann_attrs, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ANN Pre-processing — standardise numeric predictors
num_ann_cols <- top_ann_attrs[sapply(WD_country_all[top_ann_attrs], is.numeric)]

sc_mean           <- apply(WD_country_all[num_ann_cols], 2, mean)
sc_sd             <- apply(WD_country_all[num_ann_cols], 2, sd)
sc_sd[sc_sd == 0] <- 1   # prevent division by zero for constant columns

# Scale ALL country data (used for training in Q11)
WD_ann_all <- WD_country_all
WD_ann_all[num_ann_cols] <- scale(WD_country_all[num_ann_cols],
                                   center = sc_mean,
                                   scale  = sc_sd)

# Add WaveNum: numeric version of Wave for temporal modelling (Q12)
WD_ann_all$WaveNum <- as.numeric(as.character(WD_ann_all$Wave))

# Scale test country data using SAME parameters (no re-fitting)
WD_test_ann <- WD_test_country
WD_test_ann[num_ann_cols] <- scale(WD_test_country[num_ann_cols],
                                    center = sc_mean,
                                    scale  = sc_sd)
WD_test_ann$WaveNum <- as.numeric(as.character(WD_test_ann$Wave))

# Final predictor set (scaled numeric + WaveNum)
ann_preds <- c(num_ann_cols, "WaveNum")
cat("Final ANN predictor count:", length(ann_preds), "\n")

# Build and train ANN on ALL country data
# Architecture: 1 hidden layer, 5 hidden units
#   - nnet uses logistic (sigmoid) activation by default
#   - decay = 0.01 is L2 regularisation to reduce overfitting
#   - maxit = 300 allows sufficient convergence
#   - size = 5 chosen as a balance between capacity and overfitting
#     given the moderate dataset size for one country
fml_ann <- make_formula(cv_ann, ann_preds)

set.seed(33986010)
ann.model <- nnet(fml_ann,
                  data   = WD_ann_all,   # ALL country data, not just 70%
                  size   = 5,
                  maxit  = 300,
                  decay  = 0.01,
                  trace  = FALSE)

cat("ANN architecture: input =", length(ann_preds),
    "| hidden = 5 | output = 1 (sigmoid)\n")
cat("Total weights:", length(ann.model$wts), "\n")


# Evaluate on full country test set
ann.prob  <- predict(ann.model, WD_test_ann)
ann.class <- factor(ifelse(ann.prob > 0.5, "High", "Low"),
                    levels = c("Low", "High"))

actual_ann <- WD_test_ann[[cv_ann]]
cm_ann     <- table(Predicted = ann.class, Actual = actual_ann)
cat("\nANN Confusion Matrix (", top_country, "):\n")
print(cm_ann)

metrics_ann <- get_metrics(cm_ann)

print(
  kable(data.frame(Metric = names(metrics_ann),
                   Value  = as.numeric(metrics_ann)),
        caption = paste("Table: Q11 ANN Metrics –", top_country, "|", cv_ann),
        digits  = 4) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#4472C4", color = "white")
)


# ROC Curve for ANN
actual_bin_ann <- ifelse(actual_ann == "High", 1, 0)
prd_ann        <- ROCR::prediction(ann.prob, actual_bin_ann)
prf_ann        <- ROCR::performance(prd_ann, "tpr", "fpr")
auc_ann        <- round(ROCR::performance(prd_ann, "auc")@y.values[[1]], 4)

plot(prf_ann, col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2,
     main = paste("Figure: Q11 ANN ROC –", top_country, "|", cv_ann),
     xlab = "False Positive Rate",
     ylab = "True Positive Rate")
abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "grey")
legend("bottomright",
       legend = paste("AUC:", auc_ann),
       col    = "darkgreen", lwd = 2)

cat("Q11 ANN AUC:", auc_ann, "\n")

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# QUESTION 12: ANN Performance Over Two Waves
# ============================================================
cat("\n========== QUESTION 12: ANN PERFORMANCE BY WAVE ==========\n")

# Identify the two waves with most TEST observations
# for the selected country

wave_counts_test <- sort(table(WD_test_ann$Wave), decreasing = TRUE)
wave_counts_test <- wave_counts_test[wave_counts_test > 0]  # drop empty levels

cat("Test observations per wave for", top_country, ":\n")
print(wave_counts_test)

top2_waves <- names(head(wave_counts_test, 2))
cat("Top 2 waves selected:", paste(top2_waves, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Evaluate ANN separately for each of the two waves
# The SAME trained model from Q11 is used (no retraining)
wave_metrics_list <- list()
wave_auc_list     <- list()
wave_prob_list    <- list()
wave_actual_list  <- list()

col_wave <- c("blue", "red")

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

for (i in seq_along(top2_waves)) {
  wv   <- top2_waves[i]
  tdat <- WD_test_ann[WD_test_ann$Wave == wv, ]
  cat("\n--- Wave", wv, "| N test:", nrow(tdat), "---\n")

  # Predict using Q11 model
  wp <- predict(ann.model, tdat)
  wc <- factor(ifelse(wp > 0.5, "High", "Low"), levels = c("Low", "High"))
  wa <- tdat[[cv_ann]]

  # Confusion matrix
  cm_w <- table(Predicted = wc, Actual = wa)
  cat("Confusion Matrix – Wave", wv, ":\n")
  print(cm_w)

  # Metrics
  m_w <- get_metrics(cm_w)
  wave_metrics_list[[wv]] <- m_w

  # ROC & AUC
  actual_bin_w <- ifelse(wa == "High", 1, 0)
  prd_w        <- ROCR::prediction(wp, actual_bin_w)
  prf_w        <- ROCR::performance(prd_w, "tpr", "fpr")
  auc_w        <- round(ROCR::performance(prd_w, "auc")@y.values[[1]], 4)
  wave_auc_list[[wv]]    <- auc_w
  wave_prob_list[[wv]]   <- wp
  wave_actual_list[[wv]] <- actual_bin_w

  # Individual ROC plot (side by side)
  plot(prf_w, col = col_wave[i], lwd = 2,
       main = paste("Figure: Q12 Wave", wv, "–", top_country),
       xlab = "False Positive Rate",
       ylab = "True Positive Rate")
  abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "grey")
  legend("bottomright",
         legend = paste("AUC:", auc_w),
         col    = col_wave[i], lwd = 2)

  cat("Wave", wv, "AUC:", auc_w, "\n")
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))


# Combined ROC plot — both waves on same axis
plot(0, 0, type = "n", xlim = c(0,1), ylim = c(0,1),
     xlab = "False Positive Rate",
     ylab = "True Positive Rate",
     main = paste("Figure: Q12 ANN ROC by Wave –", top_country, "|", cv_ann))
abline(0, 1, lty = 2, col = "grey")

for (i in seq_along(top2_waves)) {
  wv   <- top2_waves[i]
  prd_w <- ROCR::prediction(wave_prob_list[[wv]], wave_actual_list[[wv]])
  prf_w <- ROCR::performance(prd_w, "tpr", "fpr")
  plot(prf_w, col = col_wave[i], lwd = 2, add = TRUE)
}

legend("bottomright",
       legend = paste("Wave", top2_waves,
                      "| AUC:", sapply(top2_waves,
                                       function(w) wave_auc_list[[w]])),
       col    = col_wave, lwd = 2, cex = 0.85)


# Summary comparison table across the two waves
wave_summary_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(top2_waves, function(wv) {
  data.frame(
    Wave      = wv,
    N_Test    = sum(WD_test_ann$Wave == wv),
    Accuracy  = wave_metrics_list[[wv]]["Accuracy"],
    Precision = wave_metrics_list[[wv]]["Precision"],
    Recall    = wave_metrics_list[[wv]]["Recall"],
    F1        = wave_metrics_list[[wv]]["F1"],
    AUC       = wave_auc_list[[wv]]
  )
}))
rownames(wave_summary_df) <- NULL

cat("\nQ12: ANN Performance Comparison by Wave\n")
print(
  kable(wave_summary_df,
        caption = paste("Table: Q12 ANN Performance by Wave –",
                        top_country, "|", cv_ann),
        digits  = 4,
        align   = c("c","c","c","c","c","c","c")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE) %>%
    row_spec(0, bold = TRUE, background = "#4472C4", color = "white") %>%
    column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
)

# Change summary (difference between waves)
if (length(top2_waves) == 2) {
  delta_f1  <- round(wave_metrics_list[[top2_waves[2]]]["F1"] -
                     wave_metrics_list[[top2_waves[1]]]["F1"], 4)
  delta_auc <- round(wave_auc_list[[top2_waves[2]]] -
                     wave_auc_list[[top2_waves[1]]], 4)
  cat(sprintf("\nChange from Wave %s to Wave %s:\n",
              top2_waves[1], top2_waves[2]))
  cat(sprintf("  Delta F1  : %+.4f\n", delta_f1))
  cat(sprintf("  Delta AUC : %+.4f\n", delta_auc))
}
```
